description: Two paragraphs over the day table: the trend clause through Day+3 with the sky, rain's support among the models moving one way, a day standing out for wind, the scored call with the models' votes and the met service's word, the record's best model or its absence; then the same trend measured from Day+3, which models still reach, the wetter solutions, the Day+7 call and its record. The numbers are the table's; the only probability printed is the served call's.

cases.name: the stored day: a windier Wednesday, rain gaining support, two models past Saturday
cases.expected:
Temperatures and winds much the same through Thursday, with showers possible Tuesday, dry Wednesday, rain possible from Thursday, and thunderstorms likely each day. Skies mostly cloudy throughout. Rain loses support through Thursday, from all four models Tuesday to two of four models Thursday. Windier on Wednesday, gusts to 41 km/h. Thursday's call: rain, 68%, with two of four models wet; highs 29 to 34 °C. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls it wet. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 77% of the time over 52 checks.

Further out, cooling and becoming calmer through Monday, with showers and thunderstorms likely Friday and Saturday, and showers and thunderstorms possible Sunday and Monday. Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Saturday. ECMWF and ICON are the wetter solutions from Friday to Monday; GFS and UKMO keep it drier. Monday's call: rain, 100%, with both models wet; highs 23 to 30 °C. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 80% of the time over 48 checks.
